g.text: 20-Byte Stream Framing Between UI and Daemon
Fixed binary header layout, sub-frame tick / 32KB coalescing, and sequence-indexed stream replay
Ring-buffer index; client requests missed range
Detects daemon restart / invalidates stale offsets
session_id checked cast; falls back to JSON on overflow
Sub-frame cadence prevents UI render thrash
Flushes immediately on reaching 32 KB ceiling
Reuses single contiguous frame buffer per pump
while bulk output coalesces up to 32 KB,
preventing IPC bridge saturation on burst workloads.
Monotonic ring buffer sequences allow GUI clients
to re-attach after crash or reload without dropping
or silently corrupting unobserved agent outputs.
ReplayGap packet explicitly signals ring wrap
